And of adjectives (the gender and number are the same as of the word formed by लुप् elision of the तद्धित and which they qualify) so far as the जाति (or kind of species) is concerned, (or when not expressing जाति).

Terms: तद्धित

In the Vedas, the two stars विशाखा may optionally be in the singular number.

Terms:

A case-inflected word denoting the qualifier (the Adjective), is compounded diversely with a case-inflected word denoting the thing thereby qualified, (the Substantive), the latter being in agreement (same case) with the former and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

A द्वन्द compound of words of different genders, denoting names of rivers and countries, but not of towns, is singular.

Terms: समास-द्वन्द

The affix णमुल् comes after the verbs 1. विश् 'to enter' 2. पत् 'to fall' 3. पद् 'to pace, to go' 4. स्कन्द् 'to leap', when a word in Accusative -2nd case is in composition and when the sense denoted is that of complete pervasion and total abosrption.

Terms: णमुल्

, comes after a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction in the sense of 'any body'sūtras sphere', if a country is indicated by such sphere.

Terms: अण्

The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'that whose purpose is this' after the words 1. विशाखा and 2. आषाढ when the derivative of the first is combined with मन्य and that of the second with दण्ड।

Terms: अण्

The affix अण् (अ) is added to the word विसारिन् when a word expressing 'fish' is to be made.

Terms: अण् (अ)

The word विषिकर is formed with सुट् optionally when denoting a kind of bird, the other form being विकार।

Terms: सुट् augment

The words विस्पष्ट etc. preserve their accent when followed by an adjective word in a compound.

Terms: तत्-पुरुष समास

In the room of the last consonant that follows it, of a pronoun and of the words विषवक् and देव is substituted अद्रि when अञ्च् with the affix व follows.

Terms: Some Substitution

The final vowel of विश्व is lengthened before वसु and राट् (the form assumed by राज्).

Terms: संहिता Lengthening

स् is the substitute of a विसर्ग when it is followed by a hard consonant (खर्) which itself is followed by a sibilant (शर्).

Terms: विसर्ग सन्धि
